description: Defines the ReportingReport struct and related enums and methods for handling reporting reports in the net namespace.

classes.name: ReportingReport
classes.description: Represents an undelivered reporting report with status, identifiers, URL, body, and delivery info.

methods.name: ReportingReport
methods.description: Constructor initializing a reporting report with various attributes.

methods.name: GetGroupKey
methods.description: Returns a key combining the report's source token, URL origin, and group.

methods.name: RecordReportDiscardedForNoURLRequestContext
methods.description: Records a discard event when no URL request context is available.

methods.name: RecordReportDiscardedForNoReportingService
methods.description: Records a discard event when no reporting service is available.

methods.name: IsUploadPending
methods.description: Checks if the report is currently being uploaded.
